messages.text: Hi, I'm your personal health assistant. To create the perfect plan for you, I need to know your age, weekly time commitment, 30 minutes a few times or more, workout preference, gym, home or community. Main goal, weight loss, strength, endurance, or general health. And what motivates you, friends, solo, classes, or outdoors. The more details, the better your personalized plan.
I'm 16, I get to train 30 minutes a week. My preference is at home and my main goal is to train strength and I work better alone.

Thanks for sharing that information about training strength, working alone, and having 30 minutes a week to train at home. One clarification is needed. 30 minutes a week might be a good starting point, but we usually recommend at least three, four times a week for noticeable strength gains. What are your thoughts on dedicating a bit more time per week to reaching your strength goals?
Uh yeah, no, I can't do 30 more than 30 minutes a week.

Your time commitment is set and we'll make the most of it. To proceed, I'd like to understand your strength goal a bit better. Are you focusing on building overall muscle strength or working towards specific types of exercises such as weightlifting or body weight exercises?
Yeah, since I have no equipment at home, body weight exercises, probably it.

Body weight exercises are a fantastic space to start with. Perfect. I have everything I need to create a personalized strength building plan that fits your goal and at home training space. Let me put together some recommendations that match your needs.
